Water Pollution Control and Drainage Act
(CHAPTER 348)
Declaration under Section 12
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 12 of the Water Pollution Control and Drainage Act, the Director of Water Pollution Control and Drainage hereby declares that all those parcels of land known as Lots 4628 and 4629 of Mukim 17 and situated in the District of Toa Payoh in the Republic of Singapore, having been set aside as drainage reserve pursuant to development proposals approved by the Competent Authority appointed under the Planning Act [Cap. 232], shall vest in the Government, with effect from 13th December 1996.
